description: Browse every credited artist, albums and playlists in lists or four-column grids, with live artist artwork and native music playback.
features: Independent Artists, Albums and Playlists list/four-column grid settings
Collaborations appear under every credited artist
Browse artists, then their albums, then songs
Square album artwork beside its tracks
Artist-image live thumbnails with Ken Burns slideshows and album-art fallback
Requires Eclipse host version 2 or later
